## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Type

- [ ] Engine
- [ ] Theme

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run test:visual`, if rendering or theme output changed
- [ ] Generated SVG or screenshots inspected, if rendering changed
- [ ] No personal generated data committed to `main`

## Theme checklist

For theme PRs:

- [ ] Theme directory is complete and uses schema version 1
- [ ] IDs, thresholds, references, palette contrast, and accessibility follow the theme spec
- [ ] SVG assets are static, safe, local, and within size limits
- [ ] `LICENSE.md` covers text, asset provenance, contributor rights, and any fan-work attribution
- [ ] Standard and compact visual checks pass
- [ ] No generated user journey data is included

## Notes

Add screenshots, generated SVG examples, or follow-up work here.
